dataset: Korean Elementary Learning Map full-depth integrated workstream build
sourceBasis: Merged subject workstream artifacts generated from the Korean 2022 revised curriculum source posture; stores code anchors, original summaries, provenance, mappings, and coverage gaps without copying official standard text.

textPolicy.summaryPolicy: Original summaries, source-derived paraphrases, evidence notes, and assessment prompts only; no bulk verbatim curriculum text.
textPolicy.licenseCaution: CLEARED: the cited Korean curriculum documents are state-published public materials openly available from their original sources (Ministry of Education, National Education Commission, NCIC). Preserve attribution and see PROVENANCE.md.
textPolicy.sourceEditionPolicy: Current notice edition ("현행 고시본"), not the edition currently enforced ("현재 시행판"). Where a cited edition is not yet enforced, the affected standards carry effectiveFrom and the entry is listed in effectiveFrom below.

effectiveFrom.note: 국가교육위원회 고시 제2026-1호 부칙: 초등학교 1·2학년은 2028-03-01부터 시행한다. 그 전 학년도의 현장 시행판은 교육부 고시 제2022-33호 [별책 15](첨부 10003571)이며, 이 데이터셋은 현행 고시본인 2026-1판을 따른다.
